fields.Name: mjqueue.ai-action
fields.Description: Durable processing for the legacy @memberjunction/queue 'AI Action' queue type. Disabled by default: set this topic and its subscription to Active (and run the subscription on a work-queue host) to move 'AI Action' tasks off the in-process queue.

fields.Name: mjqueue.ai-action.legacy-driver
fields.Description: Runs routed 'AI Action' tasks through the registered AIActionQueue driver.

fields.Name: mjqueue.entity-ai-action
fields.Description: Durable processing for the legacy @memberjunction/queue 'Entity AI Action' queue type. Disabled by default: set this topic and its subscription to Active (and run the subscription on a work-queue host) to move after-save Entity AI Actions off the in-process queue.

fields.Name: mjqueue.entity-ai-action.legacy-driver
fields.Description: Runs routed 'Entity AI Action' tasks through the registered EntityAIActionQueue driver, which reloads the referenced record.
